# FS User Stories

FS User Stories is an open-source, local-first macOS application for writing and sharing user stories without the overhead of a project-management suite.

## Official links

- Homepage: https://gitlares.github.io/fs-user-stories/
- Source: https://github.com/gitlares/fs-user-stories
- Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6801671870
- License: https://github.com/gitlares/fs-user-stories/blob/main/LICENSE

## Product facts

- Projects, profiles, user stories, checkable acceptance criteria, one notes field, and managed attachments.
- Exactly three story states: Draft, Active, and Completed.
- Local SQLite persistence; no required account, cloud, telemetry, subscription, sprints, estimates, owners, deadlines, or dashboards.
- Loopback-only MCP server for compatible local agents.
- Optional Git sharing through a user-controlled remote and the isolated `fs-user-stories` branch.
- Version 1.0 is available as a one-time purchase on the Mac App Store for $9.99 USD ($199 MXN) and targets Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later.
